items.difficulty_reason: Descent theorem (statement 7286-7300, proof 7302-7359): the fppf twin of the chapter's ph descent theorem - full faithfulness transfers through the comparison diagram, and the essential image is obtained via the fppf-etale sheaf descent lemma along the flat surjective degree-zero map instead of an equalizer computation; the quasi-inverse half is a complete adjoint argument; the only formal-chase step is recorded in the notes. H2: formal descent bookkeeping over established descent lemmas.
